svg.text: Raspberry Pi 5 + AI HAT+ · PCA9685 servo driver · HLK-LD2450 radar · USB camera, microphone and speaker
Servo leads: brown = ground (outer row) · red = +5 V · orange = signal
Pin 1 is the end farthest from the USB ports
Servos get power only from the 5 V supply, never from the Pi.
All grounds meet on the PCA9685. Leave its V+ header pin empty.
The radar's TX and RX cross over to the Pi.
install.sh turns on I²C and the serial port for you.
Clone PCA9685 boards: if the servo header's V+ pins read 0 V
with 5 V on the terminal, its protection MOSFET has burned out.
Check the + / − and radar pin labels on your own boards.
in an eye socket · sees people
the Pi 5 has no headphone jack
Boards drawn to scale (1 mm = 6 px); wires, cables and the boxes aren't. The PCA9685 is drawn turned around so its wires don't cross: both ends' 6-pin headers are the same.
